goal: WorkItem exposes optional priority/required_capabilities/conflict_keys fields, DirectoryWorkSource populates them from each task file, and a sync persists them into the work_items priority/required_capabilities_json/conflict_keys_json columns.

relevant: .flywheel/specs/00049-distributed-scheduling-metadata.md -- acceptance criteria #1, #2, #3 and decisions D-1, D-5, D-7 this task satisfies

packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_sources.py -- WorkItem dataclass (add the three optional fields) and DirectoryWorkSource.list_work; read the new keys from the task file the way _read_prerequisites already reads prerequisites (top-level JSON keys)

packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_claims.py -- the work_items upsert/persistence that must write the three values into the EXISTING priority/required_capabilities_json/conflict_keys_json columns (created by 00048 with defaults)
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_claims_postgres.py -- mirror the same persistence write on the Postgres backend
packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/loaders.py -- task_digest stays the content hash; do not invent a new one here
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/test_work_sources.py -- keep this suite green; it constructs WorkItem and DirectoryWorkSource
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/test_orchestrator_claims.py -- keep this suite green; it drives the claim store / work_items persistence on both backends
constraints: The three new WorkItem fields MUST be optional with defaults (priority: int = 0, required_capabilities: frozenset[str] = frozenset(), conflict_keys: frozenset[str] = frozenset()), preserving frozen + kw_only, so every existing WorkItem(...) construction without them still compiles.

DirectoryWorkSource MUST read priority/required_capabilities/conflict_keys from each task file's top-level JSON, mirroring _read_prerequisites; an absent key yields the default. Core flywheel ignores these keys (they are orchestration metadata, not part of the single-task definition).

Persistence MUST write the item's values into the existing work_items columns (priority, required_capabilities_json, conflict_keys_json) on BOTH the SQLite and Postgres backends. Do not re-create, rename, or re-default those columns -- 00048 already created them.
Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done.
non_goals: Do NOT populate these fields from GithubWorkSource -- github items stay at defaults this spec (D-7).
Do NOT change select_next_task, WorkGraph.ready_set, or the claim store acquire/renew/release/sweep -- scheduling and claim behavior are later tasks.
Do NOT change the work_items schema or bump orchestrator_schema_version -- the columns already exist; this is a data change, not a schema change.
Do NOT modify flywheel-core schema, schema_version, or task_versions.
Do NOT modify files under tests/; do not weaken or delete assertions.
edge_cases: A WorkItem constructed with only task= and source_ref= (no scheduling metadata) must construct with priority 0 and both sets empty.

A non-default item (priority 7, required_capabilities {"gpu"}, conflict_keys {"deploy"}) must round-trip through the work_items columns -- read back as 7 and the two json columns decoding (order-insensitively) to the supplied sets; a persistence path that writes the 00048 defaults (0 / [] / []) must fail.
A task file omitting all three keys must not raise and must yield the defaults.
